_comment: Single-space deploy. COMMON pattern (mirrors reference): paste .env.hf.example verbatim into GitHub Secret ENV_FILE; HF write token goes in GitHub Secret HF_TOKEN.
_docs: GitHub Secret ENV_FILE (whole .env.hf.example doc) is fanned out by deploy.yml into INDIVIDUAL HF Space secrets (PORT, SESSION_SECRET, ...) because this Go binary reads process env vars directly (no start.sh ENV_FILE parser like the reference Python service). GitHub Secret HF_TOKEN is the Space write token (hf_...).
